_what: Overlap of this paper's 11 enumerated 306-family lipidoids with data/data_vitro.csv + data/data_vivo.csv, by FULL InChIKey, SKELETON InChIKey block and IL_name. Reported, not acted on.

near_miss_tierA_exact_306_core._what: Every corpus lipid CONTAINING the tetra-substituted 306 core as a SUBSTRUCTURE (N-methyl-3,3'-dipropyl, four N-CH2CH2-C(=O)O-alkyl arms). A substructure match is a SUPERSET: a larger polyamine lipidoid that embeds this motif matches too, which is why the decisive figure here is n_identical_to_one_of_ours and not n. This is the paper's only external structure anchor: KW_2014 stores these same structures under 'C<n>' names and NC_2024 under 'O<n>' names, so the token's meaning is attested twice, independently, instead of assumed from the label.

near_miss_tierB_same_chemistry_other_ami._what: Count per experiment of corpus lipids with >=4 acrylate-ester Michael arms but NOT the 306 core -- the same lipidoid chemistry built on a different amine. Context only: it bounds how much of the corpus is the same chemical neighbourhood. Reported, not acted on.
